# Distribution Directory

This directory contains the production build files for the IIIT-Delhi Academic Dashboard.

## Purpose

- Contains compiled and optimized production-ready files
- Used for deployment to GitHub Pages or other hosting platforms
- Generated by the build process

## Usage

To generate the dist files:
```bash
npm run build
```

The build output will be placed in this directory and is ready for deployment.

## Deployment

This directory can be deployed to:
- GitHub Pages
- Vercel
- Netlify
- Any static hosting service

**Note:** Build artifacts are typically git-ignored. Only the structure is tracked.
